titles.title: T30/T31: two Stories approved in ONE sweep, built in turn — each change log is EXACTLY its own files (build-start file committed with the work)
T32: the build-start file left UNCOMMITTED (untracked) with nothing else dirty — the range is still derived, exact set
T32 (tracked and modified): a build-start file that is the ONLY dirty tracked path does not stand in for the Story's work
T33: approval arrives MID-BUILD (two-task Story, BUILD approved after task 1) — the change log is EXACTLY both tasks' files
T34: the same mid-build approval with the build-start file DELETED before task 2 — no file is written and the base is the pre-change one
T35: a REBUILD of a finished, approved Story lists EXACTLY the rebuild's files
T36 (plan-driven): implement writes NO BUILD record, and a batch approval then approves none for the Story
T36 (Small route): implement stamps and writes NO BUILD record; a batch approval approves none
Trivial route: the first implement stamps HEAD and writes its task-less record; a second implement keeps the stamp
Trivial route: validate runs the test files touched since the build-start stamp, though a later commit is HEAD (ISSUE-91640defac1b5816)
fail-open: a stamp that cannot be written leaves the implement result unchanged on every route
a REFUSED implement stamps nothing
T37: the completion writer excludes a COMMITTED build-start file — exact set
T38: no resolvable base and a clean tree -> validate writes an EMPTY change log (no substituted range)
implement: approved+fresh plan returns a prompt carrying acceptance checks + issue ref
implement: does NOT gate on the LLD open questions (resolved at stage-start now)
implement: unapproved plan returns next=refused with reason plan-unapproved
implement: a non-task target (a story) is a resolution error
validate: returns the judge verdict from a stubbed CliProvider review session
validate: a failing judge verdict gives passed:false
validate: persists a plan-driven BUILD ledger record (standalone key ABSENT since t9) recording the task + passed
validate: a BUILD-record persist failure is swallowed — the verdict is still returned
validate[standalone]: no plan → resolves identity from context, persists a BUILD record (standalone key ABSENT since t9, story task)
validate[standalone]: the persisted record carries the file-level change-log for a non-empty changed set
validate[standalone]: a persist failure is swallowed — the verdict is still returned
validate[standalone]: a Small build with no resolvable identity → err(no-identity)
validate[standalone]: the persisted record is approvable by the completion gate
implement: multi-epic dir + { target:'s1/t1', epicHash } resolves + proceeds
validate: multi-epic dir + { target:'s1/t1', epicHash } resolves + returns a verdict
implement: multi-epic dir + 's1/t1' WITHOUT epicHash still returns err(unresolved-target)
CHARACTERISATION A (INVERTED at t8): a standalone build's persisted md now RENDERS '## Scope' for its body.focus
CHARACTERISATION B (INVERTED at t9): a standalone build KEEPS meta.standalone true through validate
CHARACTERISATION C (TRIVIAL route — NOT a defect, re-labelled at t6): a CLEAN tree with NO upstream yields an empty changeLog and no '## Changes' section
t10 END-TO-END: a trivial-routed build produces ONE record carrying the change set, the summary, the commit, its scope and its route — none of which it could carry before this Story
t10 AUDIT: all three of t1's characterisations are still here, each carrying the task that INVERTED it — none deleted, none skipped
CHARACTERISATION harness: read-only — rev-list --count and status --porcelain unchanged afterwards, and the suite skips cleanly when git is unavailable
t4: the validate writer EXCLUDES its own json + md from its own change-log, keeping the Story's real change
t6 THE POINT OF THE STORY: a CLEAN tree WITH a stamped base yields the Story's committed change set
t6: a multi-task Story's change set GROWS across tasks rather than describing only the latest
t6: a DIRTY tree yields today's working-tree result and does NOT union in the committed range
t6: an UNRESOLVABLE base still WRITES the record, keeps the verdict, and substitutes no range
t6: BOTH writers resolve the SAME base for the same Story — one resolver, not two chains
t7: a SUPPLIED summary reaches body.summary
t7: NO summary supplied → the record carries NO summary key (never synthesised from the task list)
t7: an EMPTY or WHITESPACE-ONLY summary is treated as omitted, not stored as a blank
t7: the summary input is OPTIONAL — a controller that never supplies it sees no behavioural difference
validate: a standalone work item gets meta.standalone TRUE on the FIRST write, read from its definition head
validate: an EPIC-parented work item is unchanged — no flag written, record under docs/epics/
0855311b — validate, LLD-only Small story: first write is standalone, sized, and filed beside the LLD
0855311b — validate, no head and no LLD: the route the standalone branch declared is what is written
0855311b — validate: a caller's declaration does NOT relabel a story whose definition head says otherwise
0855311b — completion: an LLD-only story's record is written standalone, beside the LLD
43d72766 — a record that never got its flag is still re-rendered beside its story, and resolves by its md path
validate runs the checks before the judge and overwrites testsPassed and typecheckClean from the daemon results
a judge passed:true with a failing typecheck gives passed:false
a judge timeout returns verdict-session-timeout and writes no BUILD record
the validate judge is called through runReviewSession with the repo as cwd and a verdict schema
a judge object without a boolean passed gives unparseable-verdict
a non-timeout judge error gives verdict-session-failed and writes no BUILD record
plan-driven and standalone validate each hand the check runner the plan for their route
implement and validate return merge-in-progress while a merge is uncommitted
a validate turn with a wrong mapping returns 'invalid-test-mapping', runs no check, calls no judge and writes neither record
a second validate turn of the same Task with no mapping uses the stored one (mutation: fall back to the prefix rule when a stored mapping exists)
ISSUE-b4b6b835: validate hands the check runner the other TypeScript projects the build touched; a build inside the root project names none
a stored mapping whose file is gone gives that case not found and a failed check, and the turn is not refused
the builder's reported results never set testsPassed: a mapping of reported passes with a failing mapped case still fails
the build tool's registered input shape accepts `tests` on the validate phase, refuses an entry or a case with a key the shape does not have, and the schema lookup returns the field

a validate turn with a mapping writes the test record, the build record links to it, the change log leaves out both records' files, and the verdict's evidence carries the cases with their results and the record's path

when the test record cannot be written the verdict is returned unchanged with a note; on a first turn the build record carries no testRecord, and on a second turn the record on disk still shows the first run with its commit and time (mutation: let the write's error escape)

when the judge session throws after the checks ran, the turn returns the same error as before, the test record holds this run's results with testsPassed from the tests check and the supplied mapping, and the build record is not written (mutation: write the test record in the build record's write, after the judge)

a trivial standalone build validated with no implement turn before it, whose judge fails on the first turn and passes on a turn dated a day later, has its BUILD.md and TESTS.md in one folder; with an implement turn first, the BUILD record it wrote is the anchor and the test record follows it; and a small standalone build's test record carries the declared standalone flag before any BUILD record exists and the same when the first BUILD record is written by the completion path (mutation: anchor the BUILD record on its own time when a test record exists)

a standalone validate call on a Story whose definition head is silent about standalone files TESTS.md beside BUILD.md under docs/epics, and the test record carries no standalone flag (mutation: hand the test record the raw declaration)
when the Story's route cannot be resolved, the verdict is returned with a note and neither record is written on that turn
a stored test record that cannot be read is said so in the verdict, and a stored reported result is not reused once its test is no longer live
on the standalone routes: a wrong mapping on a small build is refused with 'invalid-test-mapping', a good one is planned by subject, and `tests` is ignored on a trivial build
builder text in the judge's evidence is kept to one line
c00559b7 — implement + validate admit t1 of a standalone LLD+PLAN (was unresolved-target)
resolveTaskTestFiles maps plan test names to tracked __tests__ files, de-duplicates, and lists names with no match as unresolved
a base name under two __tests__ directories resolves to both files
the plan-driven, small and trivial routes each build the expected check plan
a trivial build with a range base runs the test files touched across base..HEAD, not only the HEAD commit's (ISSUE-91640defac1b5816)
a test name whose only *.test.ts token is not a leading prefix is unresolved, and the file it mentions is not run
a plan is given the other TypeScript projects that own a file the build changed since its base, or a test file; a build inside the root project names none
the typecheck is run in the root and in each named project; it is clean only when all are, and each command and output is kept
a passing and a failing command give ok true and ok false with their exit codes and output tails
a command past its limit is reported timedOut and its whole process group, grandchild included, is gone
a test file that keeps its process alive after its tests pass still finishes under --test-force-exit
an unresolved test name makes tests fail with a note naming it
a trivial build that deletes a test file does not ask to run it
with no mapping, planTaskCheckPlan and smallStandaloneCheckPlan return the same testFiles, unresolvedTests and noTests as before, and namedTests marks each name 'prefix' or 'none'

with a mapping, a name with no prefix is no longer unresolved, its files are in testFiles once, and a name with both a mapping and a prefix uses the mapping (mutation: keep the prefix's files as well)
smallStandaloneCheckPlan with a mapping and no prefixed subject runs the mapped files and is not 'the LLD names no test file'; an unmapped prose subject is listed as not mapped and does not fail
runValidationChecks runs each file in its own process, in order, with the TAP reporter, and returns per file its exit code and titles (mutation: run all files in one command)

a mapped case that passes, one that fails, one that is skipped and one whose title is not in the file get those four results, and the check is not ok when any is fail, skipped or not found (mutations: count not found as pass; count skipped as pass)
a file that exits non-zero while its mapped cases pass fails the check and lists the other failing titles
a file that times out, and a file not started because the time limit was used up, are recorded with that note, their cases are not found, and the check is not ok
a run's whole output is written to a file and its path returned, with nothing cut; when that file cannot be written the results stand and the entry carries a note

a reported pass on a live test runs nothing and leaves the check's result to the other tests; a reported fail makes the check not ok; a Task whose tests are all reported as pass runs no file and passes with the note, while a Task with no file and an unreported name still fails (mutation: fail every run that has no file)
trivialCheckPlan marks each touched file 'touched' and the result lists every title of each file
a file whose output is not TAP fails the check even when it exits with 0 and no case is named for it
a line a test prints that looks like a result line, or like the start of a YAML block, is not read as one: the runner reports a test's output as comments
the whole output is still written after the output directory has been removed, and files older than the retention are pruned
ISSUE-7ba8cf15: a file with many tests is reported in full under the gate's runner, every case found (mutation: run the file under --test, whose force-exited child cuts the report short)
ISSUE-7ba8cf15: in its own process a failing test still fails the file
ISSUE-7ba8cf15: when no report file can be made the file is not run, its entry says why and the check fails, and nothing throws
